        Batch Acceptance Test BAT-09 - Rev B

1. Objective
Verify a complete automatic batch cycle using the effective setpoints and approved return routing. The test is
primarily a controller/architecture acceptance test; the WaterNaCl property package may be replaced by
StandardWater for topology debugging, but final composition-based acceptance uses the composition-capable
configuration.

2. Initial conditions

 Item                                                         Initial condition
 Simulation time                              0 s
 B1 composition                            w_NaCl = 0.000
 B2 composition                            w_NaCl = 0.250
 B3-B7                                      Near empty; level <=0.01 m except unavoidable residual volume
 Ambient pressure                            101325 Pa
 Ambient temperature                           293.15 K
 All automated valves                           Closed
 P1, P2                                              Off
 B5 heater / B6 cooler / B7 cooler                    Off
 K1 cooling-water flow proof                          Available, >=0.10 kg/s when heater demanded

3. Acceptance sequence

 Check                                 Acceptance criterion
 B3 water prefill                            Step1 exits at LIS-301 >=0.13 m
 B3 recipe                                 Step2 exits at QI-302 >=0.080 kg/kg
 B3 empty                                 Step3 exits below 0.01 m
 B5 charge                                Step5 exits at LIS-501 >=0.18 m
 Evaporation                               Step6 exits at QIS-502 >=0.180 kg/kg
 B6 cooling                                 TIS-602 <=20 degC before P2 return
 B7 cooling                                 TIS-702 <=25 degC before P1 return
 Routing                             B6 condensate returns to B1; B7 concentrate returns to B2
 Parallel join                                Cycle reset cannot occur until both branches complete
 Cycle restart                                               Initial becomes active only after process time >2500 s

4. Logging
Log at 5 s or faster: state/region, all tank levels, QI-302, QIS-502, TI-503, TIS-602, TIS-702, FIS-801, P1/P2,
heater/cooler commands and all 15 automated valve commands.
